g.text: CN3791 MPPT Li-ion charger: up to 4x 5V solar panels (diode OR) -> 1S LiPo (4.2V)

g.desc: CN3791 MPPT Li-ion charger: up to 4x 5V solar panels (diode OR) -> 1S LiPo (4.2V)

g.text: INA219 I2C power monitor (0x40), switchable between solar input and battery

g.desc: INA219 I2C power monitor (0x40), switchable between solar input and battery

g.text: - Solar inputs J1-J4: up to four 5V panels in parallel, each isolated by a 1N5819 (40V/1A). MPPT senses VIN after these diodes,

g.desc: - Solar inputs J1-J4: up to four 5V panels in parallel, each isolated by a 1N5819 (40V/1A). MPPT senses VIN after these diodes,

g.text: so each panel sits ~0.3-0.45V above the 4.6V setpoint (~4.9-5.0V, typical Vmp of a 5V panel). One panel alone carries ~0.9A at 1A charge.

g.desc: so each panel sits ~0.3-0.45V above the 4.6V setpoint (~4.9-5.0V, typical Vmp of a 5V panel). One panel alone carries ~0.9A at 1A charge.

g.text: - MPPT setpoint: VMPPT = 1.205V x (1 + R3/R4) = 1.205 x (1 + 28.0k/10k) = 4.58V. Charging starts once MPPT > 1.23V (VIN > 4.68V).

g.desc: - MPPT setpoint: VMPPT = 1.205V x (1 + R3/R4) = 1.205 x (1 + 28.0k/10k) = 4.58V. Charging starts once MPPT > 1.23V (VIN > 4.68V).

g.text: - L1: datasheet requires L > 5 x (VCC - VBAT) uH = 16uH at 6V Voc / 2.8V batt. 22uH gives ~0.2A ripple at 6V in, 3.7V batt.

g.desc: - L1: datasheet requires L > 5 x (VCC - VBAT) uH = 16uH at 6V Voc / 2.8V batt. 22uH gives ~0.2A ripple at 6V in, 3.7V batt.

g.text: - Datasheet blocking diode D1 omitted to save ~0.4V headroom: D5-D8 keep the battery out of the panels; the CN3791 then draws ~21uA

g.desc: - Datasheet blocking diode D1 omitted to save ~0.4V headroom: D5-D8 keep the battery out of the panels; the CN3791 then draws ~21uA

g.text: from the battery via L1 and Q1's body diode when dark (datasheet p.9). Reference D1 is intentionally unused.

g.desc: from the battery via L1 and Q1's body diode when dark (datasheet p.9). Reference D1 is intentionally unused.

g.text: - Status: D4 red ON = charging, D3 green ON = charge done. Both off = no input or VIN < VBAT.

g.desc: - Status: D4 red ON = charging, D3 green ON = charge done. Both off = no input or VIN < VBAT.

g.text: - Panel-mount SPST switches plug into J7/J8 (JST-XH, 3A; PH is used for panels/battery so leads can't be swapped).

g.desc: - Panel-mount SPST switches plug into J7/J8 (JST-XH, 3A; PH is used for panels/battery so leads can't be swapped).

g.text: J7 SW_BATT isolates the cell from charger and load. J8 SW_LOAD switches only VOUT (J6), so the cell keeps charging with it off.

g.desc: J7 SW_BATT isolates the cell from charger and load. J8 SW_LOAD switches only VOUT (J6), so the cell keeps charging with it off.

g.text: Rate both switches >= 1A or the module's peak current, whichever is higher (battery current is charge OR load, not the sum).

g.desc: Rate both switches >= 1A or the module's peak current, whichever is higher (battery current is charge OR load, not the sum).

g.text: With SW_BATT off in sun the CN3791 sees no battery and VBAT pulses near 4.2V: keep SW_LOAD off then.

g.desc: With SW_BATT off in sun the CN3791 sees no battery and VBAT pulses near 4.2V: keep SW_LOAD off then.

g.text: - INA219 (U2, I2C 0x40 with A0=A1=GND). SW3 selects the shunt: SOLAR = R7 (PV -> VIN), current from the panels, bus voltage = VIN;

g.desc: - INA219 (U2, I2C 0x40 with A0=A1=GND). SW3 selects the shunt: SOLAR = R7 (PV -> VIN), current from the panels, bus voltage = VIN;

g.text: BATT = R6 (BATT+ -> cell), + charging / - discharging, bus voltage = cell voltage (readable even with SW_BATT open).

g.desc: BATT = R6 (BATT+ -> cell), + charging / - discharging, bus voltage = cell voltage (readable even with SW_BATT open).

g.text: Shunts 0.1R match the common INA219 breakout, so stock library calibration (32V/2A, PGA /8 = +/-320mV = +/-3.2A) works as-is.

g.desc: Shunts 0.1R match the common INA219 breakout, so stock library calibration (32V/2A, PGA /8 = +/-320mV = +/-3.2A) works as-is.

g.text: J9 to MCU: 1 VCC_MCU (3.3-5V, powers U2 and pull-ups), 2 SDA, 3 SCL, 4 GND. R8/R9 10k pull-ups: omit if the MCU board has them.

g.desc: J9 to MCU: 1 VCC_MCU (3.3-5V, powers U2 and pull-ups), 2 SDA, 3 SCL, 4 GND. R8/R9 10k pull-ups: omit if the MCU board has them.
